name: zn15_12_get_lots_surrounding_rect
description: Conformance test 12 (GetLotsSurroundingRect, §8.3 slot 10). Lot A is 1 × 1 at (2, 2) (token 0x1000); lot B is 2 × 2 at {3,2,4,3} (token 0x1001). The ring one cell outside B is walked row by row; a lot that does not intersect the rect is appended once. Side bits: 1 = row z1-1, 2 = column x2+1, 4 = row z2+1, 8 = column x1-1. flags 0xF -> every ring cell: A at (2,2) is on the x1-1 = 2 column -> [A]. flags 2 (only the x2+1 = 5 column) -> nothing there -> []. flags 8 (only the x1-1 = 2 column) -> [A].
